title: About African Bison Classic Tours
paragraphs: Africa Bison Classic Tours is a premier travel and tour company based in Nairobi, Kenya, specializing in delivering unforgettable wildlife safari experiences across East Africa. Established with a passion for showcasing the unparalleled beauty of Africa’s wilderness, we are dedicated to providing personalized, professional, and eco-conscious safari adventures in Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, and Zanzibar.

Our Mission Our mission is to connect travelers with the heart of Africa by offering exceptional safari experiences that celebrate the region’s breathtaking landscapes, vibrant cultures, and extraordinary wildlife. We aim to promote sustainable tourism practices that benefit local communities and protect natural habitats for generations to come.
Our Vision To be the leading safari operator in East Africa, renowned for our commitment to quality, innovation, and sustainability in the travel industry.
We have partnered with a number of companies including Africa Safaris to bring you a variety of World class destination routes in Africa.

Experience the magic of the African wilderness with guided safaris in renowned national parks and reserves, including the Maasai Mara, Serengeti, Amboseli, Bwindi Impenetrable Forest, and Ngorongoro Crater. Combine your safari adventure with a relaxing retreat to the pristine beaches of Zanzibar, Mombasa, or Lamu. Embark on life-changing gorilla trekking expeditions in the misty forests of Uganda and Rwanda. Immerse yourself in the rich heritage of East Africa with visits to local communities and cultural landmarks. Whether you seek luxury accommodations or budget-friendly options, we tailor our tours to meet your needs and preferences.We also customize safari packages for corporate teams, groups, and special events.
Expertise and Local Knowledge : With deep roots in East Africa, our team possesses unparalleled knowledge of the region’s attractions and hidden gems.
Personalized Experiences : We take pride in crafting tailor-made itineraries that cater to your unique interests, ensuring a truly bespoke safari experience.
Commitment to Sustainability : We support eco-friendly practices, partner with conservation initiatives, and work closely with local communities to ensure responsible tourism.
Safety and Comfort : Our well-maintained fleet of safari vehicles and professional guides ensure your journey is safe, comfortable, and memorable.
24/7 Support : From planning your trip to the final day of your safari, our dedicated team is available around the clock to assist you.

Witness the Great Migration in the Maasai Mara, explore the diverse ecosystems of Amboseli and Tsavo, or marvel at the flamingos of Lake Nakuru.Track mountain gorillas in Bwindi, spot chimpanzees in Kibale Forest, and cruise the Nile in Murchison Falls National Park. Discover the Serengeti’s vast plains, scale Mount Kilimanjaro, or relax on the idyllic beaches of Zanzibar. Unwind on white sandy beaches, explore historic Stone Town, or snorkel in turquoise waters teeming with marine life.
Join Africa Bison Classic Tours for an adventure of a lifetime and create memories that will stay with you forever. Explore East Africa with us—where the wild meets wonder!
